notes: As fb-travel-3701-80pct-taxed, but the employer is satisfied that at least 80% of the vehicle use is business: only 20% = R1 000 of the R5 000 allowance is remuneration (G21 p. 5). Taxable 31 000; x12 = 372 000; tax = 44 118 + 26% x (372 000 - 245 100) = 77 112; less 17 820 = 59 292; /12 = 4941.00. The calculator taxes the whole allowance. SDL AND NET ADDED (FB review round 2): SDL: the SDL-flagged 3701 counts at its PAYE share (SDL Act s3; Fourth Schedule para 1; G21 p. 5): 1% x R31 000 = R310.00. Net = R35 000 cash - PAYE 4 941.00 - UIF 177.12 = R29881.88; the benefit is non-cash, so it is in neither gross nor net pay. These two figures are derived from the cited rules and the sourced PAYE and UIF, not read from a payslip.
